semantic.justification: Task172 restores actual shared SfxItemPool master/secondary links, detach/attach propagation, terminal traversal, metadata-based lazy merged ranges, secondary default/slot resolution and native pool-only SfxItemSet construction. Native WhichRangesContainer value storage is immutable JS tuple arrays; MergeRange remains in original itemset implementation responsibility and type declarations move to the canonical whichranges header. Ordered insertion/adjacent union preserves independent values; the first native needMerge conjunct is redundant for sorted valid inputs. Native includes produce a safe ES-module function-binding cycle used only after initialization, with no import-order workaround. Logical range cache retention after secondary changes is preserved (CALC151). Existing explicit-range Writer callers and its separate browser snapshot/default registry remain intact; that registry does not invent native metadata ranges. No smart-pointer/refcount/cache-manager library is added; GC owns object lifetime. Full native named/copy/shutdown/user-default pool contracts, styles/document/UI/ODS remain pending.
